article.title: Price discrimination for peace?
article.excerpt: Want some hummus with a side of coexistence? A restaurant near the coastal city of Netanya recently started offering 50 percent off each plate of the chickpea paste at tables seating Jews and Arabs together. There is more here , and for the pointer I thank Ari.
